release_read.basis: Profit line crushed the guide (non-GAAP op income $31.2m vs $20-24m guide, diluted non-GAAP EPS $0.17 vs $0.11-0.13), FY raised to $744-748m revenue and $0.61-0.63 EPS (from $732-746m / $0.50-0.54) with Q4 guided $198-202m above the ~$192-200m the old FY implied; revenue beat is only ~1% over consensus and RPO fell again sequentially ($334m vs $340.9m) with top-10 concentration up to 39%, which caps it well inside the 18% implied move after a 22% run-in fall.

key_line.detail: RPO $334m, up 24% y/y but down sequentially from $340.9m in Q2 (and $368.7m in Q1); top-ten customers 39% of revenue vs 32%; security revenue $44.7m +32% y/y, decelerating from 43-47%; LTM NRR 119% vs 117%. Network services growth not separately read in time.

guidance.detail: Q4 revenue $198-202m, non-GAAP op income $30-34m, non-GAAP EPS $0.16-0.18; FY26 revenue $744-748m (was $732-746m), non-GAAP op income $107-111m, non-GAAP EPS $0.61-0.63 (was $0.50-0.54). Street Q4 consensus not found in time.

call.detail: Call held last night; no transcript or call commentary found in the time available. The -16% pre-market against a beat-and-raise release suggests the call (or the sequential RPO decline / rising concentration / revenue decelerating to a ~1% beat) carried the negative, as in May and August 2026, but this is inference, not a sourced fact.

public_reaction.summary: No post-release analyst action, headline or retail thread on the Q3 2026 print was found in two searches before 09:20 ET; earlier quarters (May, Aug 2026) show the same pattern of beats being sold, with May's pre-market drop of about 21% extending to -38% by the close.

tape_read.note: Robust reference $17.70 is -15.9% vs the $21.03 close (after-hours -16.3%, last print -16.8%), inside the 18.1% implied move; active pre-market (85 prints, 16 in the last 30 min, last at 09:16, not stale), sagging from a $18.62 high to the $17.30-17.70 low end. Against my frozen +9% release read the tape is 25 points lower, so the market is pricing something not in the release text (most likely the call or the RPO/concentration lines); I call it an overshoot relative to the release but with low confidence because I did not read the call. QQQ -1.1% is a headwind.

thesis_check.note: The thesis (bar reset by a 22% fall into a beat-and-raise) is confirmed on the numbers: profit well above guide, FY raised. The brake named in the hunt (RPO decline, concentration) also showed up: RPO fell again sequentially and top-10 share rose to 39%. The tape says the brake won, the third beat-and-raise in a row to be sold.

expected.open_lag_note: Active, non-stale pre-market with an overnight to digest an amc print, so the open should hold most of the -16% (low p_open_lags). A large gap tends to give part back by 10:00, and the release itself is positive, which leans to a partial bounce; against that, the pre-market has sagged to its lows, QQQ is -1.1%, and this name's May drop extended hard after the open.

recommendation.reason: De positie staat voorbeurs ongeveer 16% verlies, terwijl de cijfers zelf goed zijn (winst ver boven de eigen prognose, jaarprognose verhoogd). Grote openingsgaten geven in het eerste half uur vaak een deel terug, en een positie tegen de gap in wint daar meestal bij; daarom om 10:00 verkopen in plaats van bij de opening. Het vertrouwen is laag: we kennen de inhoud van de call niet, en in mei liep een vergelijkbare daling na de opening juist verder door.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Als de koers voor 09:30 onder het voorbeurslaagste punt van $17,30 zakt of er een analistenverlaging met een negatieve call-toelichting (bijv. verlies van een grote klant) verschijnt, dan gewoon bij de opening verkopen.
